groups.market_hint: Will early polling for the 2028 presidential race show a wider lead for candidates aligned with the Marcos bloc?
groups.R_reason: Civic protests and general electoral polarization are long-term, organic trends with fuzzy tracking parameters.
groups.S_reason: Local election bodies (COMELEC) or reputable survey firms (Pulse Asia / SWS).

groups.U_reason: Partisan politics shifts rapidly depending on coalition announcements.
groups.H_reason: Highly discussed, but too broad compared to specific candidate/arrest events.

groups.resolution_source: Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) official press statements or Department of National Defense (DND) briefings.

BDLT.B_reason: Moderate betting appeal among provincial observers and security analysts.
BDLT.D_reason: Skeptics who point out recurring insurgent activity vs. optimists backing government announcements.
BDLT.L_reason: Directly affects security and local economies across several Philippine islands.

groups.why_users_bet: Insurgency eradication targets have high local significance and represent major, trackable milestones in national security.
